site.title: Everyday AI, Done Right
site.tagline: Real AI leverage. Actually free. No credit card.

articles.title: Zero-Cost AI Tools & API Catalog 2026
articles.hook: Access GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 2.5, Llama 3.3 70B, and DeepSeek R1 for $0.00/month — no credit card required, verified permanent free tiers only.
